name: Tea Cream
description: Historical recipe from The Virginia Housewife; Or, Methodical Cook (1824). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: the best tea
ingredients.originalText: one ounce of the best tea

ingredients.name: tea-spoonsful of a strong infusion of rennet in water
ingredients.originalText: four tea-spoonsful of a strong infusion of rennet in water

instructions.text: Put one ounce of the best tea in a pitcher, pour on it a table spoonful of water, and let it stand an hour to soften the leaves
Then put to it a quart of boiling cream, cover it close
In half an hour strain it
Add four tea-spoonsful of a strong infusion of rennet in water, stir it
Set it on some hot ashes, and cover it
When you find by cooling a little of it, that it will jelly, pour it into glasses, and garnish with thin bits of preserved fruit

source.author: Mary Randolph
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put one ounce of the best tea in a pitcher, pour on it a table spoonful of water, and let it stand an hour to soften the leaves
2. Then put to it a quart of boiling cream, cover it close
3. In half an hour strain it
4. Add four tea-spoonsful of a strong infusion of rennet in water, stir it
5. Set it on some hot ashes, and cover it
6. When you find by cooling a little of it, that it will jelly, pour it into glasses, and garnish with thin bits of preserved fruit
